releaseNotesMarkdown:
### VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics (victoriametrics/victoria-metrics)

### [`v1.155.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.155.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.154.1...v1.155.0)

#### [v1.155.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.155.0)

Released at 2026-10-23

**Update Note 1:** `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): `/admin/tenants` requests without `start` and `end` query args now return tenants for the current day. This is a breaking change because previously it was expected to return all tenants. If you still need to retrieve all tenants, set the `start` and `end` params so that the resulting time range fully includes the `-retentionPeriod`. Also note that [vmctl](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/) is known to send requests to `/admin/tenants` under the hood when migrating data between VictoriaMetrics deployments. Therefore, make sure that you run `vmctl` with both `*-filter-time-start` and `*-filter-time-end` params. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#​11791](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

- SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.2 to Go1.27.3. See [the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.3](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).

- SECURITY: upgrade base docker image (Alpine) from 3.24.2 to 3.24.3. See [Alpine 3.24.4 release notes](https://alpinelinux.org/posts/Alpine-3.21.9-3.22.7-3.23.7-3.24.3-released.html).

- FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add `-healthcheck` command-line flag, which checks that the running process accepts connections at `-httpListenAddr` and exits with non-zero code if the check fails. This allows setting up Docker `HEALTHCHECK` in images without `curl` or `wget`. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/url-examples/#health) and [VictoriaLogs#1565](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1565).

- FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: expose `process_cpu_cores_host`, `process_cpu_cores_cgroup_quota`, `process_memory_host_bytes` and `process_memory_cgroup_bytes` metrics. Cgroup metrics are `-1` if no cgroup limit is set or the limit cannot be read. See [#​11460](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11460).

- FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): deprecate Server URL editing and show a warning when using a saved custom URL. Existing custom URLs continue to work. See [#​11735](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11735).

- FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): update the appearance of error, warning, info, and success messages. See [#​11736](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11736).

- FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): add a tenant column to Top Queries and Active Queries when tenant information is available. See [#​6346](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/6346).

- FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): limit tenant discovery to the selected time range. See [#​11784](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11784).

- FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): limit the number of logged parse errors per each scrape of a target via `-promscrape.maxParseErrorsPerScrape` command-line flag (20 by default). The number of suppressed parse errors is logged after the scrape. This prevents log flooding from targets exposing many malformed lines. See [#​8856](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/8856).

- FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): restore Prometheus compatibility for alerts state restoration, so Prometheus can be used as `-remoteRead.url` again. Previously, the restore query used MetricsQL function `default_rollup()` which Prometheus rejects, so the state of alerting rules with `for > 0` was reset on every vmalert restart. See [#​11574](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11574).

- FEATURE: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): export `vm_request_duration_seconds{path="/admin/tenants"}` for tracking time it takes to fetch [tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) from the database.

- FEATURE: [dashboards](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/tree/master/dashboards): apply the instance filter to the `CPU pressure`, `Memory pressure`, `IO pressure`, and `Memory allocations rate` panels in the Resource usage section of the [VictoriaMetrics - cluster](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/11176-victoriametrics-cluster/) dashboard. Displays zero disk I/O and syscall rates. See [#​11742](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11742).

- FEATURE: [alerts-health](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-health.yml): add `TooManySnapshots` alerting rule. It notifies about instances where more than 2 [snapshots](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-work-with-snapshots) are stored for at least 2 hours. Such snapshots are usually left behind by failed `vmbackup` / `vmbackupmanager` runs. They keep references to the already merged data parts and prevent [background merges](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#storage) from freeing the disk space, which results in excessive disk usage. See [#​9344](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/9344).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): prevent [Kafka remote write](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/) getting stuck after TLS certificates are reloaded. Previously, when vmagent detected changed certificates and restarted the Kafka producer, pending sends to the old producer could hang forever and the remote write queue stopped draining until vmagent was restarted. Now such sends are retried with the new producer. See [#​11737](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11737).

- BUGFIX: `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent metric metadata drops after transient RPC handshake timeouts when connecting to `vmstorage`. See [#​11762](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11762). Thanks to [@​sakateka](https://redirect.github.com/sakateka) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly validate time series ingested via [`/api/v1/import/native`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-import-data-in-native-format). See [#​11745](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11745). Thanks to [@​meshchellomishel](https://redirect.github.com/meshchellomishel) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): reduce memory usage during for Kubernetes service discovery, when scrape configuration has many entries that matches small subset of targets. See [#​11751](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11751). Thanks to [@​CamberLoid](https://redirect.github.com/CamberLoid) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent search requests panic. See [#​11788](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11788) for details.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): set `__meta_kubernetes_namespace` and the namespace metadata to the namespace of the `Endpoints` or `EndpointSlice` object in [`role: endpoints`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#kubernetes_sd_configs) and `role: endpointslice` service discovery when the referenced pod lives in another namespace. Previously the namespace of the pod was used, unlike Prometheus. See [#​11798](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11798). Thanks to [@​cestercian](https://redirect.github.com/cestercian) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): skip keys with unsupported `kty` or `crv`, missing required members or invalid values in the JWKS fetched via [OIDC discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#oidc-discovery) instead of rejecting the whole key set, as required by [RFC 7517](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7517#section-5). Previously, a single unsupported or malformed key in the JWKS caused vmauth to reject all JWTs from that issuer, including tokens signed with supported keys. See [#​11748](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11748).

- BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): stop saving the automatically calculated query step in shared URLs, so opening a link recalculates the step for the selected time range and screen width. Explicitly configured steps remain fixed. See [#​11638](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11638).

- BUGFIX: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): change the default time range for [/admin/tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) HTTP endpoint to search tenants only for the current day instead of searching the entire `[0, now]` time range. This should prevent unnecessary load on `vmstorage` and prevent OOMs. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#​11791](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

### [`v1.154.1`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.154.0...v1.154.1)

##### [v1.154.1](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.1)

Released at 2026-10-19

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): do not slow down requests with auth tokens if no `users` are configured. Previously, such requests were delayed by 2-3 seconds before being proxied to `unauthorized_user`, though there were no users to brute-force. This affected setups where one `vmauth` authenticates requests and proxies them to another `vmauth` with only `unauthorized_user` configured. The bug has been introduced in [v1.154.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.0). See [#​11774](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11774).
